mapper.select: SELECT * FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT * FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND aggregate_id = #{aggregate} AND task_type='ai_turn' AND state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM taskoutbox FORCE INDEX (ix_taskoutbox_ready_scope) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type IN ('ai_turn','business_callback') AND payload_json<>'{}' AND state<>'PROCESSING' AND REPLACE(aggregate_id,'-','') IN (SELECT REPLACE(CAST(id AS CHAR),'-','') FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finished_at <= #{cutoff} AND status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL')) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND state='COMPLETED' AND updated_at <= #{cutoff} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM callsession c WHERE c.tenant_id=taskoutbox.tenant_id AND REPLACE(CAST(c.id AS CHAR),'-','')=REPLACE(taskoutbox.aggregate_id,'-','') AND c.finished_at <= #{cutoff} AND c.phone LIKE 'redacted:%' AND c.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL')) ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{p1} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND state='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<=#{p1}
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND state IN ('PENDING','FAILED','PROCESSING') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND aggregate_id=#{p1} AND task_type='after_playback' AND state='PENDING'
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (task_type=#{p0} AND state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND available_at<=#{p1}) ORDER BY available_at LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (task_type='ai_turn' AND state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND available_at<=#{p0}) ORDER BY available_at LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (id=#{p0} AND state='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{p1} AND locked_at>#{p2})
SELECT * FROM `taskoutbox` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (id=#{p0} AND state='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{p1} AND locked_at>#{p2}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM taskoutbox FORCE INDEX (ix_taskoutbox_ready_scope) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type IN #{type} AND state='PROCESSING' AND locked_at <= #{cutoff} AND attempts >= max_attempts LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM taskoutbox FORCE INDEX (ix_taskoutbox_ready_scope) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type IN #{type} AND available_at <= #{now} AND attempts < max_attempts AND (state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') OR (state='PROCESSING' AND locked_at <= #{cutoff})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM taskoutbox older WHERE taskoutbox.task_type<>'after_playback' AND older.tenant_id=taskoutbox.tenant_id AND older.aggregate_id=taskoutbox.aggregate_id AND (older.task_type=taskoutbox.task_type OR (older.task_type IN ('recording_ingest','recording_delete') AND taskoutbox.task_type IN ('recording_ingest','recording_delete'))) AND older.state IN ('PENDING','FAILED','PROCESSING') AND (older.created_at<taskoutbox.created_at OR (older.created_at=taskoutbox.created_at AND older.id<taskoutbox.id))) ORDER BY available_at,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE taskoutbox SET locked_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id=#{id,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND state='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND locked_at > #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT state,COUNT(*) AS n FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY state
SELECT state AS value,COUNT(*) AS total FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY state
